t: You are on Pont Street, a fashionable street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, running between Knightsbridge and Belgravia. Harrods is not far to the north-west. The street crosses Sloane Street in the middle, and Hans Place and Cadogan Square lead off it, while the eastern end heads toward Belgrave Square. Two baronets are linked to it. Sir Thomas Skinner was a financial writer, publisher and businessman who became a director of the Canadian Pacific Railway and governor of the Hudson's Bay Company, and he lived here. Sir Coles Child lived here too, and died here.
